questions.q: If the sequence of the coding strand in a transcription unit is 5'-ATGCAT-3', what will be the sequence of the transcribed mRNA?
questions.qPa: ਜੇਕਰ ਟ੍ਰਾਂਸਕ੍ਰਿਪਸ਼ਨ ਯੂਨਿਟ ਵਿੱਚ ਕੋਡਿੰਗ ਸਟ੍ਰੈਂਡ ਦਾ ਕ੍ਰਮ 5'-ATGCAT-3' ਹੈ, ਤਾਂ ਬਣਨ ਵਾਲੇ mRNA ਦਾ ਕ੍ਰਮ ਕੀ ਹੋਵੇਗਾ?
questions.explanation: The mRNA sequence is exactly the same as the coding strand (which is 5' to 3'), except that Thymine (T) is replaced by Uracil (U). Therefore, ATGCAT becomes AUGCAU.

questions.q: In a double-stranded DNA molecule, if the percentage of Adenine is 15%, what is the percentage of Guanine?
questions.explanation: If A = 15%, then T = 15% (total 30%). The remaining 70% must be G and C. Since G = C, Guanine is half of 70%, which is 35%.

questions.q: Which type of RNA brings amino acids to the ribosome during translation?
questions.explanation: Transfer RNA (tRNA) acts as an adapter molecule that reads the codon on mRNA and brings the corresponding amino acid to the ribosome.

questions.q: In which direction do DNA and RNA polymerases catalyze the synthesis of a new strand?
questions.explanation: All known DNA and RNA polymerases synthesize new nucleic acid strands exclusively in the 5' to 3' direction, adding nucleotides to the 3'-OH end.
